body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> RIM presented its multimedia smartphone 'Curve 8310' during CES 2009, which enhanced GPS functionality. Adopting a 2M camera, a full qwerty keyboard and 320*240 resolution display, the Curve 8310 supports microSD card slot, USB connectivity, 3.5mm stereo head jack and Bluetooth.
